'''Deep harbors''' were massive [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].

==Description==
Deep harbors were enormous [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] built into the side of the station's biggest trench. Their massive size allowed them to hold a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] or other [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] types.<ref name="DSTC 2">[[Death Star Technical Companion (Second Edition)|''Death Star Technical Companion'', Second Edition]]</ref> A deep harbor drydock located on a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was large enough to accommodate a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] and multiple [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Visionaries">''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]''</ref>
